articles.description: An all-time NBL performance from Kendric Davis led the Sydney Kings to a 106 - 93 game 3 win against the Adelaide 36ers in front of a sold out Qudos Bank Arena.

articles.headline: Kinsey, Bassey lead Warriors' 16-point comeback win over Squadron
articles.description: The Santa Cruz Warriors rallied to overcome a 16-point second-half deficit and defeat the Birmingham Squadron 121-117 at Kaiser Permanente Arena on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Pullin's 29 power Iowa Wolves past Rip City Remix
articles.description: Zyon Pullin scored 29 points and was one of four starters to score at least 22 as the Iowa Wolves defeated the Rip City Remix 136-117 on Wednesday night at the Chiles Center in Portland, Oregon.

articles.headline: Taylor, Garcia lead Capitanes past Boom
articles.description: Behind strong performances from Wade Taylor IV and Andersson Garcia, the Mexico City Capitanes defeated the Noblesville Boom 122-110.
